advice.aqi.good: Air quality is good — enjoy outdoor activity.
advice.aqi.satisfactory: Air is satisfactory; sensitive people may feel minor discomfort.
advice.aqi.moderate: Breathing discomfort possible for people with asthma or heart disease.
advice.aqi.poor: Breathing discomfort for most people on prolonged exposure. Limit outdoor exertion.
advice.aqi.very_poor: Respiratory illness on prolonged exposure. Avoid outdoor exercise; wear an N95 outdoors.
advice.aqi.severe: Serious health effects for everyone. Stay indoors, run an air purifier, avoid all outdoor exercise.
advice.visibility.excellent: Clear all round — no visibility concerns.
advice.visibility.moderate: Slight haze — keep headlights on outside town.
advice.visibility.poor: Reduced visibility — slow down and use low beams.
advice.visibility.very_poor: Very poor visibility — avoid overtaking, use fog lamps.
advice.visibility.dense_fog: Dense fog — travel only if necessary, use hazard lights at a crawl.
advice.pollen.low: Pollen is low — no precautions needed.
advice.pollen.moderate: Moderate pollen — allergy sufferers should carry medication.
advice.pollen.high: High pollen — keep windows shut in the morning and shower after being out.
advice.pollen.very_high: Very high pollen — stay indoors during the morning peak if you have allergies.
advice.uv.low: UV is low — no protection needed.
advice.uv.moderate: Use sunscreen and seek shade around midday.
advice.uv.high: Use SPF 30+, a hat and sunglasses.
advice.uv.very_high: Avoid the sun between 11:00 and 16:00; reapply sunscreen every 2 hours.
advice.uv.extreme: Extreme UV — stay in the shade; unprotected skin burns in minutes.
advice.heat.hydrate: Drink water every 30 minutes, even without thirst.
advice.heat.stop_work: Heat stroke risk — stop outdoor work and stay indoors.
advice.frost.irrigate: Irrigate lightly in the evening — wet soil releases heat overnight.
advice.frost.cover: Cover nursery beds and vegetable seedlings.
advice.commute.leave_early: Leave early; expect slow traffic and standing water.
advice.school.normal: Normal school run — nothing special needed.
advice.swim.safe: Sea conditions are suitable for a swim near the shore.
